HeroVideoSlide.title: HeroVideoSlide
HeroVideoSlide.description: A hero showcase video slide displayed in the storefront HeroBanner and managed in AdminDashboard settings.

id.description: Unique identifier matching the document ID.

kicker.description: Eyebrow kicker text above the headline.

videoSrc.description: Uploaded /media/hero-videos path, bundled /assets/videos path, or HTTPS video URL.

posterSrc.description: Fallback poster image path or HTTPS URL.

posterAlt.description: Accessible alt description for fallback poster.

categoryTarget.description: Target category filter when clicking Explore.

featuredProductId.description: Optional featured product ID linked in the hero CTA.

startingPrice.description: Starting price displayed if matched product is unavailable.

sortOrder.description: Display order index in the hero slider.

active.description: Whether this video slide is active on the public storefront.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the slide was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the slide was last updated.

updatedByUid.description: UID of the authenticated admin who saved the slide.

HeroConfig.title: HeroConfig
HeroConfig.description: Global hero showcase playback and active slide settings.

activeSlideId.description: Preferred default hero video slide ID.

autoAdvanceSeconds.description: Seconds between automatic hero slide transitions.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when config was last updated.

updatedByUid.description: UID of the authenticated admin who updated the config.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Authorized store administrator record keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

Category.title: Category
Category.description: Storefront phone brand category or nested sub-category managed in the Admin Dashboard.

id.description: Unique category identifier matching document ID.

name.description: Display name of the phone brand or sub-category.

slug.description: URL-safe lowercase slug for category filtering and routing.

brandKey.description: Built-in phone brand icon key or custom.

featured.description: Whether this category is featured on the storefront slider.

active.description: Whether this category is active and visible on the public storefront.

parentId.description: Parent category ID for sub-categories, or empty string for top-level phone brands.

googleCategory.description: Optional Google product taxonomy category label.

image.description: Optional HTTPS URL, local asset path, or compressed image data URI.

sortOrder.description: Display order index among sibling categories.

isDefault.description: Whether this category is one of the default store brands.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the category was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the category was last updated.

updatedByUid.description: UID of the authenticated admin who saved the category.

/heroVideos/{slideId}.description: Hero section video slides managed by admins and read by the public storefront HeroBanner.

/heroConfig/{configId}.description: Hero carousel playback settings (default slide ID and auto-advance timing).

/categories/{categoryId}.description: Hierarchical store categories and brand sub-categories managed by admins and read by the public storefront.
